The public license key for your company license, obtained from the License keys page on [remotion.pro](https://remotion.pro/dashboard). If you are eligible for the free license, pass "free-license".

## CLI flag

```text
--public-license-key <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setPublicLicenseKey('your-license-key');
```
